newsitem.title: USA: Oppenheimer Funds buy Jefferson-Pilot unit.
newsitem.headline: Oppenheimer Funds buy Jefferson-Pilot unit.

text.p: Oppenheimer Funds Inc bought the investment advisory business of Jefferson-Pilot Corp, the companies said.
As part of the deal, the four mutual funds of JP Investment Management Co will be merged into funds currently managed by Oppenheimer.

The Jefferson-Pilot Investment Grade Bond Fund will be merged into the Oppenheimer Bond Fund and the Jefferson-Pilot Capital Appreciation Fund will be merged into the Oppenheimer Growth Fund. Both are Jefferson retail funds.
Two funds sold to insurance companies -- the JP Investment Grade Bond Fund and the JP Capital Appreciation Fund will be merged into the Oppenheimer Bond and Growth Funds.
The four Jefferson funds have total assets of about $172 million.
